description:
Voices and voice blocks; free. set_voice: the narrator's or a
character's voice; every speaker needs one before the voiceover.
rescan_blocks: split the active script into voice blocks again after an
edit, assets untouched; blocks whose words are unchanged keep their
audio. settings: the voice engine and narrator speed.

action.description: set_voice: speaker, voice_id; rescan_blocks; settings: voice_tts_provider and/or narrator_speed

narrator_speed.description: settings: speaking rate, 0.5-2.0 (default 1.0); pauses come only from `<break>` tags

voice_id.description: set_voice: a voice id from voiceover_read action=voices

name: voiceover_edit
title: Edit voices and voice blocks
